about.title: About me
about.bio:
Frontend Developer/Engineer based in Caracas, Venezuela, with 4+ years of professional experience. I specialize in engineering fast, accessible, and high-performance web interfaces that bridge the gap between complex business logic and seamless user experiences.
My core stack revolves around React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Having led digital transformations—including migrating legacy systems to modern architectures—and worked within high-scale corporate environments, I prioritize clean code and software reliability through automated testing. I am currently evolving my design system expertise by transitioning from Chakra UI to shadcn/ui to build even more flexible and lightweight components.
When I'm not shipping features, you'll likely find me diving into gaming.

experience.title: Experience
experience.compass: Developed and shipped new features on a crypto mining platform serving thousands of users. Worked across the React component tree, improved UI performance, and contributed to code reviews and testing.
experience.onpoint: Led frontend development as the primary engineer. Designed and built the company's web presence end-to-end, focusing on lead generation, clear UX, and fast load times.
experience.setlife: Full-stack development across frontend and backend services. Built and maintained features using React and Node.js, collaborating closely with the product and design teams.

projects.title: Projects
projects.setlife: Corporate website for Setlife Solutions. Focused on performance, visual clarity, and effectively communicating the company's value proposition.
projects.onpoint: Lead generation and information site for an insurance company. Built to inform visitors and convert them into prospects through clear UX and fast load times.
projects.compass: Feature development, refactoring, code reviews, and testing on a crypto mining platform serving thousands of users.
